description: x402-polyperp-book: Level-2 order book for one Polymarket Perps market, with the microstructure a trading agent needs before sending an order — best bid and ask, spread in absolute terms and basis points, midpoint, and cumulative bid/ask depth plus their imbalance. Thin books and lopsided depth are how you spot a bad fill in advance. Works on equities, indices and commodities as well as crypto.
name: x402-polyperp-book
